Original GURPS conversion by Enraged Eggplant, from Monsters (May 11, 2024); adapted and republished with permission.

## Exact-identity cost discrepancies

15 discrepancies across 14 monsters. 14 adopt the native GCS library value because the stated cost does not follow from the published cost table for the construction; 1 preserves the source value because the difference is a deliberate convention.

| Monster | Construction | Source | Library | Adopted | Basis |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Athach | IQ-2 | -20 | -40 | **-40** (library) | Reduced IQ is -20 per level (B15), so IQ-2 is -40. The stated -20 prices one level. |
| White Dragon | Clinging (Specific, Ice, -60%) | 6 | 8 | **8** (library) | Clinging is 20 points (B43); at -60% it is 8. The stated 6 prices a -70% construction. |
| Behir | FP+4 | 8 | 12 | **12** (library) | Extra Fatigue Points are 3 per point (B16), so FP+4 is 12. The stated 8 prices at 2 per point. |
| Chimera | Per+5 | 50 | 25 | **25** (library) | Increased Perception is 5 per level (B16), so Per+5 is 25. The stated 50 prices at 10 per level. |
| Chimera | Will+5 | 50 | 25 | **25** (library) | Increased Will is 5 per level (B16), so Will+5 is 25. The stated 50 prices at 10 per level. |
| Monstrous Scorpion (Huge) | DR 4 | 40 | 20 | **20** (library) | Damage Resistance is 5 per level (B46), so DR 4 is 20. The stated 40 prices at 10 per level. |
| Digester | IQ-6 | -140 | -120 | **-120** (library) | Reduced IQ is -20 per level (B15), so IQ-6 is -120. The stated -140 prices seven levels. |
| Dire Tiger | ST+19 (No Fine Manipulators, -40%; Size Modifier, -20%) | 68 | 76 | **76** (library) | Increased ST is 10 per level (B14): 190 at -60% is 76. The stated 68 does not follow from the listed modifiers. |
| Gargoyle | Per+4 | 40 | 20 | **20** (library) | Increased Perception is 5 per level (B16), so Per+4 is 20. The stated 40 prices at 10 per level. |
| Frost Giant | ST+30 (Size Modifier, -20%) | 210 | 240 | **240** (library) | Increased ST is 10 per level (B14): 300 at -20% is 240. The stated 210 prices a -30% construction. |
| Stone Giant | ST+31 (Size Modifier, -20%) | 217 | 248 | **248** (library) | Increased ST is 10 per level (B14): 310 at -20% is 248. The stated 217 prices a -30% construction. |
| Howler | DR 2 (Tough Skin, -40%) | 3 | 6 | **6** (library) | Damage Resistance is 5 per level (B46): 10 at -40% is 6. The stated 3 prices one level. |
| Scorpionfolk | IQ-2 | -20 | -40 | **-40** (library) | Reduced IQ is -20 per level (B15), so IQ-2 is -40. The stated -20 prices one level. |
| Tarrasque | Super Jump 2 (Costs Fatigue, 1 FP, -5%) | 18 | 19 | **19** (library) | Super Jump is 10 per level (B89): 20 at -5% is 19. The stated 18 rounds the wrong way. |
| Gray Render | Parthenogenesis | 0 | 1 | **0** (source) | The fan document lists Parthenogenesis as a zero-point feature throughout, while Power-Ups prices it as a 1-point perk. This is a consistent conversion convention, not an arithmetic slip, so the author's zero-point treatment is preserved and the one-point difference is recorded rather than corrected. |

Every one of the 14 adopted corrections is the same class of error: the stated cost prices a different number of
levels, or a different modifier total, than the construction the document itself writes down. They are worth
reporting upstream to the author as errata rather than treating as intentional.

## What review could not do here

Opening each `.gct` in the GCS desktop application and visually confirming the displayed ancestry total, attribute
effects, and modifier application is a manual step that no script performs. Every affected record names its own
`.gct` in `provenance.conversionNotes`, so the remaining work is enumerable rather than open-ended:

- 40 drafts to open and check for a decomposable grouped construction;
- 14 drafts whose corrected trait costs should be
  confirmed against the displayed total after the library values were adopted.
